This is the reading copy of the Computing with AI course material. The worked
answers are in `notebooks/` in the repository, and they will reach this site
through the hint tiers. If something stops working on your computer or your
connection, you can still read the lesson.

## The course, stage by stage

::: {.cwai-stages}
::: {.cwai-card}
[Stage 0]{.cwai-card-eyebrow}

### [Warm-up](notebooks/00-warmup/index.qmd)

Getting your Codespace running and your first cell executed, before the course
proper starts.
:::

::: {.cwai-card}
[Stage 1]{.cwai-card-eyebrow}

### [Programming from first principles](notebooks/01-foundations/index.qmd)

Python through transport data from the first cell, with engineering practice --
tracebacks, `assert`, the debugger, `pytest` -- part of the work from the start.
:::

::: {.cwai-card}
[Stage 2]{.cwai-card-eyebrow}

### [AI-accelerated and agentic workflows](notebooks/02-ai-accelerated/index.qmd)

Autocomplete first, then agentic coding, framed as generate, then interrogate.
:::

::: {.cwai-card}
[Stage 3]{.cwai-card-eyebrow}

### [Direct machine learning](notebooks/03-machine-learning/index.qmd)

A training loop written by hand in PyTorch, then the same model in Keras for
contrast, and the metrics that survive class imbalance.
:::

::: {.cwai-card}
[Stage 4]{.cwai-card-eyebrow}

### [Project](notebooks/04-project/index.qmd)

An open project on a question you choose, demonstrated live as a working
notebook with a short presentation.
:::

::: {.cwai-card}
[Optional]{.cwai-card-eyebrow}

### [Stretch](notebooks/90-stretch/index.qmd)

Extra material for when you have finished a stage and want to go further.
:::
:::

Use the bar at the top of every page to move between stages. The stage you are
in is marked, and each stage lists its notebooks as they are published.

## Two ways through the material

Both routes cover the same material. Pick the one that suits you today. You can
switch at any time.

::: {.cwai-routes}
::: {.route}
### Codespace-first

You work in your GitHub Codespace and run the notebooks there. You type the code,
change it and see what happens. Use this site as **reference**: the
[glossary](glossary.qmd), the [data page](data.qmd) and a second look at an
explanation.

::: {.route-when}
Choose this if you are comfortable in a code editor and want to learn by doing.
:::
:::

::: {.route}
### Site-first

You read each notebook here first, from top to bottom, then open the same
notebook in the Codespace and run it. The Codespace is somewhere to type; the
explanation is on this page.

::: {.route-when}
Choose this if you would rather understand a step before you try it. Choose it
too if you are new to programming and want to see a result first.
:::
:::
:::

## If your Codespace will not connect

::: {.cwai-notice}
Keep going on this site. Read the notebook, follow the output, and use the
glossary for any word you do not know. Reconnect when you can and run the
notebook then. **You lose minutes, not a morning.**
:::
